ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Low internal contrast; the ventral surface is predominantly comprised of low-intensity pixels (dark gray) with high-intensity pixels (white) appearing only as sparse speckling and distal tip clusters, representing a ratio of approximately 0.05:1.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: The surface is characterized by a primary dark contiguous pigment. High-intensity light-gray/white speckling is mapped to the lower-central region above the peduncle and along the distal edges. Distinct high-contrast contiguous white blobs are located at the extreme left and right distal tips.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: A distinct V-shaped central depression with an approximate interior angle of 105 degrees and a vertical pixel depth roughly 25% of the total fluke height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: The trailing edge exhibits an irregular, non-linear boundary; the right lobe displays a sequence of 4-5 high-amplitude peaks (serrations), while the left lobe shows a higher frequency of low-amplitude undulations.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: The lobes exhibit a symmetrical upward sweep; the superior boundary of the trailing edge follows a concave arc from the median notch to the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Dense clusters of high-contrast white circular and semi-circular pixel formations are mapped to the distal tips of both lobes; smaller, isolated high-intensity spots are detected in the mid-ventral region.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Prominent irregular high-intensity white textural anomalies at the distal lobe tips, indicating localized physical surface disruption.
other_distinctive_markers: Transient high-intensity pixel noise (water droplets and spray) is visible along the perimeter of the trailing edge and scattered across the ventral surface.
